dedupe_keys.name: unit based industrial ammonia nh3 emissions in china 1998 2003 2008 2013

description: This dataset gives geolocated ammonia emissions for individual industrial units in China. The Dryad record says it covers nitrogen fertiliser production, catalytic cracking, coke, iron and steel, wastewater treatment and soda ash production for 1998, 2003, 2008 and 2013, plus cement production, waste incineration and coal-fired power plants for 2013, with unit longitude and latitude. The abstract reports 798 gigagrams of industrial ammonia emitted in China in 2019 across eight industries and 27 process categories. It was published by a Peking University team (version 6, April 2022) under the CC0 licence, free to download, about 0.9 MB. Coverage is China at unit level. Caveats: the file format and exact columns are not stated on the page read, the methods are only in the article, and 2019 values in the abstract are not among the listed file years. For simulation it gives a point-source inventory of fertiliser, coke, steel and cement units to map heavy industry and its air quality impacts. Related catalogue records include the China Cement Industry Dataset and Climate TRACE.
name: Unit-based industrial ammonia (NH3) emissions in China (1998, 2003, 2008, 2013)
provider: Peking University authors (Chen Yuang and others), via Dryad
